entities.summary: Richard W. DiPietro Jr. is an American former professional ice hockey goaltender and current co-host of ESPN New York's "DiPietro and Rothenberg" with Dave Rothenberg. He is also an analyst on National Hockey League (NHL) telecasts on ESPN having started the 2021–22 season.
